name: Basics
description: Cross-agent git workflows. Works on Claude Code, Codex, Gemini.

actions.label: Commit
actions.description: Commit current changes with an AI-written message.
actions.template: Commit the current changes with a clear message. Don't commit any files that contain secrets.

actions.label: Resolve conflicts
actions.description: Resolve merge conflicts, asking before guessing.
actions.template: Resolve the current merge conflicts. Ask before guessing on anything ambiguous.

actions.label: Sync
actions.description: Pull the latest from main and fix conflicts.
actions.template: Pull the latest from {main} into this branch and fix any conflicts.

actions.label: Push branch
actions.description: Push this branch to the remote, fixing any pre-push hook failures.
actions.template: Push this branch to the remote (`git push -u origin HEAD` if there is no tracking branch yet). If the push is rejected by a pre-push hook (lint, type-check, tests, formatter, etc.), read the error output, fix the underlying problem, commit the fix, and push again. Repeat until the push succeeds. Never bypass hooks with --no-verify.

actions.label: Create PR
actions.description: Open a PR for this branch against main.
actions.template: Create a PR for this branch against {main}.

actions.label: Review
actions.description: Run the agent's built-in code review on this branch.
